subject: english
question:
Which word is closest in meaning to self-possessed?

The child was self-possessed and confident, far beyond her years.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Composed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"self-possessed"** means being calm, confident, and in control of one's emotions or behavior. (स्वयं पर नियंत्रण रखना)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the difficult situation, the speaker remained self-possessed and handled the questions with grace.
 
 
• The word **"composed"** is closest in meaning to self-possessed as it also means calm, serene, or in control of emotions. (शांत और नियंत्रित)
 
 
• **Example: **She appeared composed even during the stressful interview.
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that "composed" is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Composed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Nervous** (घबराया हुआ): Easily agitated or distressed, especially in the face of anxiety or fear.
 
 
• **Example: **He was nervous before giving his first public speech.
 
 
 
• **Rude** (असभ्य): Lacking respect or courtesy in behavior or speech.
 
 
• **Example: **The waiter was rude and did not attend to the customers properly.
 
 
 
• **Silent** (चुप): Not speaking or making noise; quiet or reserved.
 
 
• **Example: **The room fell silent when the teacher entered.
